31st. JULYf 2013 No. S 58 SEAL

CONSTITUTION OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM

PROCLAMATION OF EMERGENCY

HIS MAJ E STY TH E SULTAN

AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM ln the name of Allah, the compassionate, the Merciful PRAISE be to ALLAH, the Lord of the Universe, and m ay the benediction and peace of ALLAH be upon Our Leader Muhammad and upon all his Relations and Friends. WHEREAS it is provided under Article 83 ( 1 ) of the Constitution of Brunei Darussalam (hereinafter referred to as "the Constitution"), that whenever it appears to His Maj esty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan that an occasion of emergency or public danger IS lmminentf exists or has ansen whereby the security or economic life Of Brunei Darussalam, or a ny part thereof, is or may be threatened, whether by war or external aggression or internal disturbance, actual or threatened, he may by Proclamation (hereinafter referred to as a "Proclamation of Emergency") declare a state of emergency either in the whole Brunei Darussalam or in such part of Brunei Darussalam as m ay be specified in the Proclamation of Emergency; AND WHEREAS on the 8th d ay of Ramadhan 1432 Hijriah corresponding to the 9th d ay of August 2011 , we did DECLARE AND PROCLAIM a state of emergency in the whole of Brunei Darussalam AND WHEREAS it is provided under Article 83 ( 2 ) of the Constitution that no Proclamation of Emergency shall be in force for more than two yearsr without prejudice, however, to the right of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan to issue another such Proclamation at or before the end of that period, AND WHEREAS it is provided under Article 83 ( 2A ) of the Constitution that notwithstanding Article 83 ( 2 ) of the Constitutionr His Maj esty the Sultan and 1207

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE Yang Di-Pertuan may by another such Proclamation declare the cessation Of a state Of emergency in the whole Of Brunei Darussalam or in such part Of Brunei Darussalam as may be specified in the Proclamation before the end Of two years; AND WHEREAS it appears to US that an occasion of emergency or public danger is immlnentf exists or has arisen whereby the security or economic life Of Brunei Darussalam, or any part thereoff is or m ay be threatened; NOWf THEREFORE, wef SULTAN HAJI HASSANAL BOLKIAH MU'IZZADDIN WADDAULAH IBNI AL-MARHUM SULTAN HAJI OMAR 'ALI SAIFUDDIEN SA'ADUL KHAIRI WADDIENf SOVEREIGN AND CHIEF OF THE FAMILY ORDER OF THE C ROWN OF BRUNEI, Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan of the State and Territory of Brunei Darussalam and all its Dependencies; Do hereby DECLARE AND PROCLAIM as of this d ay a state of emergency in the whole of Brunei Darussalam AND do hereby REVOKE our said recited Proclamation of Emergency done on the 8th day of Ramadhan 1432 Hijriah corresponding to the 9th day of August 2011 · So be it. Such is the Proclamation of Emergency. M ay ALLAH to Whom be praised and Whose name be exalted the King of Kingsr vouchsafe His grace and m ay the Prophet Muhammad ()n Whom be the benediction and peace of ALLAH) grant His Blessings to this Proclamatiom Amen! O Lord of the Universe. Done at the lstana Nurul lman, Bandar Seri Begawanr Brunei Darussalam this 7th. d ay of Ramadhan , 1434 Hijriah corresponding to the 16th. day of July, 2013 纟 being the forty-sixth year of Our Reign.

BY COMMAND

AWANG YAHYA BIN HAJI IDRIS Permanent Secretary, Office oe the Prime Minister, Brunei Darussalam. Dicetak oleh PENGIRAN HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI WIJAYA PENGIRAN HAJI AIIMAD, Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan/ Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510 , Negara Brunei Darussalam. Harga B $ 5 · oo
